Native ID3DXSprite Draw may enqueue triangles from a previous owner; R84 HudBatch tracks exact homogeneity, native session generation, pending count, queue state and game sprite and can restore only a proven physical Flush/End GPU batch.

Both Flush and End conservatively clear only unproven direct GOAL ownership and restore previous semantics afterward, with original native Draw and HRESULT unchanged and queue, +TIME, pause, lens and SkyGlow not widened.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original GOAL progress 0x4973C0 -> native progress SpriteNodes and result/time producers can cause ID3DXSprite Draw to enqueue deferred GPU triangles before the later native Flush/End in R84.
diagnosis.root_cause: FlushDest/EndDest shielded an unproven earlier native D3DX batch from the live StageExtensionTime direct owner but not the analogous exact GOAL direct owner; a foreign physical Draw could therefore inherit the current GOAL ScreenHud token.
source_trace: Original EXE GOAL 0–99 percent result/progress and time glyph E8 calls enter exact native direct/queue producer scopes.
The D3DX Draw registration captures a HudBatch ledger, which may be unproven or mixed while the original GOAL scoped CPU caller remains live during Flush/End.
Native physical Flush and End use the same bounded fail-closed submission shield for GOAL and +TIME, preserving the existing R84 strict eye ownership admission and real D3DX HRESULT.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only source-proven homogeneous original GOAL physical GPU batches may be restored for R84 left and right eyes; an unproven GOAL batch retains the conservative game fallback without inventing binocular evidence.
alternatives_rejected: Do not relabel all generic screen text or queued GOAL nodes; their existing exact parent and epoch ownership has priority.
Do not flush per glyph, change GOAL timer/progress logic, hide the native original GPU Draw or alter ordinary F11/pause and unrelated world/lens/SkyGlow.
Do not treat one passing compile or a source-level static predicate as real headset binocular correctness.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Native physical D3DX Flush/End source fix with compile-time positive/negative GOAL and +TIME regression guards; final GitHub CI and Quest3 checks pending.
